property_summary: For any depositor, calling withdrawAll once never transfers more Ether than the depositor's recorded credit, because the reference clears credit before the external call; the buggy version does not clear credit before the call, so a re-entrant callback can withdraw the same credit again and drain extra Ether.
change_summary: Move the state update `credit[msg.sender] = 0;` from before the external call to after it, making the function reentrant.
